answer: In PoA, each interaction updates an EigenTrust-style matrix, while reputation has an exponential temporal half-life, so credibility requires sustained honest service rather than a brief burst. Freshly spawned sybil identities possess near-zero eigenvector centrality because no trusted paths bridge them to established agents; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot elevate a ridge of colluding nodes. Consequently, they cannot pass consensus or establish a haven.
